title: xo inbox (~/.quirq/inbox.json)
description: Information that arrived in the workspace, its seen/done state, and the feeder cursors. Written by the inbox service (services/inbox/) and hand-editable: unknown keys at the top level and per item survive a rewrite, items without a valid id or title are dropped, an invalid status becomes new.

sources.description: Per-feeder configuration. Absent means the defaults; a source with enabled=false is never read.

issues.description: GitHub issues from every project's issue mirror (~/.quirq/projects/<pid>/github/issues.json). Only rows in a watched state are surfaced; an issue that leaves every watched state is marked done.

connections.description: Items collected by the connections poller (~/.quirq/connections/<toolkit>/events.jsonl). One cursor for every toolkit; without one only the last 24 hours are read.

cursors.description: Newest producer timestamp each feeder has seen, stored as the producer wrote it. Delete a key to re-read that source (bounded: the timeline and connections feeders then keep only the last 24 hours, the issues feeder the last 7 days).

items.description: Newest first by ts. At most 500 after a write (oldest done items go first); done items older than 30 days are pruned.

source.description: timeline | todos | sharing | issues | connections | api | anything an agent posts.

kind.description: session.started, todo.blocked, sharing.fetched, issue.open, gmail.unread, note, ...

link.description: Where the Open action goes. Unknown keys are dropped; an empty object becomes null.

view.description: A Space UI view id (projects, sessions, ...).

path.description: Project-relative, no leading slash, no .. segment.

url.description: Where the Open link action goes (the issue page, the mail, the calendar event). An invalid value is dropped on read.

key.description: Stable dedup identity for ingested items; API-created items carry none.
